layout: 3 columns x 4 rows; head 6, trail 3, contact 3
arrow: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D animation atlas for a hand-inked wilderness survival game. Make ONE transparent PNG with EXACTLY THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, twelve isolated sprite cells. Prefer a 1536x2048 portrait canvas, cells aligned as a precise 3x4 grid. No text, labels, grid, border, scenery, ground, shadow or checkerboard. Crisp hand-painted illustrated shapes, tapered dark ink accents, simplified readable silhouettes at 48-96 pixels, limited textured shading. Every sprite is centered at its cell center with a fixed pivot, identical scale for all six head poses. All directional art points horizontally RIGHT (+X). Reading order: first TWO rows are SIX sequential looping head frames; third row is THREE lifetime stages of ONE detached tiny trail particle; fourth row is THREE stages of ONE short contact effect: small flash, expanded fragments, fading fragments. Broad transparent gutters. Head frames contain only the projectile and close attached accents: no long tail or distant debris. Tail and impact are separate smaller assets, not extra full projectiles. Preserve clean transparent alpha outside the painted shapes. SUBJECT: MAGICAL ARROW. A slender ivory-bone-edged TURQUOISE arrowhead, short dark wooden shaft, and two small ivory fletching fins at the left end; all together read as one horizontal arrow. Sharp long right-pointing tip with a narrow cyan luminous inner blade. Keep it slim, about 65% of cell width and 20% of cell height, the point is at fixed x in all six frames. A clean spear-like arrow silhouette distinctly unlike a broad icy shard. Six frames keep shaft/head rigid while a narrow cyan gleam travels from base to tip and back through a seamless loop, with two tiny close energy strokes flickering along edges. No large swirling ribbons, no multiple arrows, no curved bow, no broad ice crystal. Trail row: a detached thin horizontal cyan brush dash, then a shorter pale teal dash, then a tiny dim blue-green fleck; bright end faces right, always same center, about 20% cell width. Impact row: a very small pointed pale cyan contact flash, then two or three thin ivory-cyan chips, then tiny teal flecks; keep narrow and restrained, no large explosion ring.
